c74object.name: touch.mbutton
c74object.digest: Multi-button 1D array strip with event routing and activity gate
c74object.description: Modernized touch-optimized multi-button strip for Cycling '74 Max 9 (v8ui / jsui). Configurable as a horizontal row or vertical column of buttons supporting both independent (multi-selection) and live (exclusive radio) group modes. Features per-button action modes (momentary, toggle, touch-hold), slash-delimited dual-state labels ("OffText/OnText"), loop-safe re-entrancy protection, full array state list on Outlet 0, targeted event streaming on Outlet 1 for direct pairing with route, a signum activity gate on Outlet 2, a 3-tab carousel parameter inspector, and real-time Theme Master synchronization.

inlet.description: Accepts index/state pairs ([0 1], [1 0]), targeted button messages (button_1 1, btn_2 bang), direct tag messages (edit 1, snap bang), silent updates (set 0 1, set 1 0 1 0), full state lists, integers, bang, and all configuration attributes.

outlet.digest: All button states as list [s0 s1 ... sn]
outlet.description: Outputs a full binary list representing the active state of every button in the strip ([1 0 0 1]).

outlet.digest: Targeted event message [tag/index, state] for route
outlet.description: Transmits targeted event pairs: [tag, state] (e.g. edit 1, snap 0, or 0 1 if unlabeled). Designed to connect directly to route so that only the specific button that changed fires its respective outlet.
Outputs a binary master activity gate: 1 if any button in the strip is currently active (> 0), and 0 when all buttons are off. Replaces external lookup and unpack gate subpatches.

method.name: bang
method.description: Simulates a click/tap on Button 0, respecting its assigned operating mode (Momentary flash, Toggle latch, or Touch-Hold pulse).

method.name: int
method.description: If button count is 1, sets the single button's state (0 or 1). If count is greater than 1, triggers the button at the specified zero-based index.

method.name: list
method.digest: Set button state or full array
method.description: Accepts either a 2-element pair [index, state] (e.g. 0 1 to turn Button 0 ON) or a full state list matching the button count (e.g. 1 0 1 0). Only broadcasts to outlets if a state change actually occurs.

method.name: set
method.description: Updates button states visually in memory without firing any output messages through the outlets. Accepts set [index, state] or set [s0, s1, ...]. Essential for feedback loops and preset recall.

method.name: clear
method.description: Resets all buttons in the array to state 0 and broadcasts updates.

method.name: dump
method.description: Re-transmits current states out all three outlets.

method.name: button_N / btn_N
method.description: Targeted addressing using 1-based indexing (e.g. button_1 1, button_2 0, btn_3 bang).

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens (1), closes (0), or toggles the floating Attrui parameter inspector window.

method.name: update
method.description: Reloads and re-renders visual palettes from the shared memory theme bus (Global("touch_theme_bus")) or persistent dictionary store. Also accepts aliases theme_update and refresh_theme.

attribute.name: count
attribute.description: The number of button cells in the 1D strip (1 to 64, default: 1). Instantiating at 1 allows the component to function as a standalone button.

attribute.name: direction
attribute.description: 0 = Horizontal (single row of tabs); 1 = Vertical (single column stack).

attribute.name: group_mode
attribute.description: 0 = Independent (every button toggles/triggers on its own; multiple buttons can be active simultaneously); 1 = Live (exclusive radio group matching live.tab; activating one button turns all other buttons off).

attribute.name: modes
attribute.description:
Space- or comma-separated list defining the action mode for each button slot:
0 = Momentary (flashes on click for the duration of flash_time then returns to 0)
1 = Toggle (alternates between 0 and 1 on each press)
2 = Touch-Hold (active 1 while mouse is held down, returns to 0 on release)
Example: modes "1 1 0 2" configures two toggles, one momentary flash, and one touch-hold button.

attribute.name: flash_time
attribute.description: The duration in milliseconds that momentary buttons (mode 0) remain active before resetting to 0 (default: 100 ms).

attribute.name: labels
attribute.description: Space-separated or quoted string defining button labels. Supports slash-delimited dual-state text formatted as "OffText/OnText" (e.g. "Touch/Hold", "Mute/Active", or "Off/On"). Single-token names (e.g. "Snap") remain static across both states. Unassigned slots automatically display dimmed <empty> text.

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description:
Text abbreviation algorithm applied to button labels:
0 = Full (complete label string rendered)
1 = No Vowels (strips inner vowels while preserving initial characters)
2 = Caps Only (extracts capital letters and digits; falls back to initials)
3 = First Letter (extracts the first letter of each word)
4 = No Text (suppresses label text completely)

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description:
Text capitalization normalization:
0 = First Cap (Title Case)
1 = All Cap (Uppercase)
2 = All Small (Lowercase)

attribute.name: font_style
attribute.description:
Font posture and weight:
0 = Regular
1 = Bold
2 = Italic
3 = Bold Italic

attribute.name: font_name
attribute.description: Name of the font family used to render button labels.

attribute.name: text_size
attribute.description: Point size of rendered button labels (minimum 6 pt).

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Curvature radius of the outer chassis body and reticle corner arcs in pixels (0 for sharp corners).

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke width of the 4 outer corner reticle brackets in pixels.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of the straight tick arms extending from each corner arc along the chassis edges.

attribute.name: active_mask_tab
attribute.description:
Active parameter page displayed inside the floating inspector window:
0 = 1. Performance
1 = 2. Geometry / Labels
2 = 3. Colors

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Enables the red popup launcher dot and right-click / ctrl-click access to the floating inspector window.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: 1 = Full mode (displays carousel parameter tabs, fixed 280 px width); 0 = Mini mode (collapses parameter rows, unlocks free 1-axis drag sizing).

attribute.name: popup_mini_size
attribute.description: Width and height [W H] in pixels of the floating inspector window when in collapsed mini preview mode.

attribute.name: text_color_mode
attribute.description: 0 = Auto Luminance (calculates background relative luminance and selects light or dark text dynamically); 1 = Manual / Master (strictly follows text_color).

attribute.name: btn_color_off
attribute.description: RGBA fill color of button cells in the inactive (0) state.

attribute.name: btn_color_on
attribute.description: RGBA fill color of button cells in the active (1) state. Synchronized with highlight_color on the Theme Master bus.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the outer corner reticle brackets and hairline cell dividers.

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: RGBA typography color for button labels when manual color mode is active.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the upper-right corner inspector launcher dot.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: Base background fill color for the floating parameter inspector window.

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: Background fill color for individual 50/50 attribute rows.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: Outline stroke color for attribute cells and slider troughs.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: Fill color for attribute drag sliders inside the inspector.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: Font color for parameter titles and numerical values inside the inspector.
